name: CinemaCity Download Lab
description: CinemaCity Download Lab 2.0.0. Fixes a bug that corrupted recovered function bodies (the naive // comment stripper ate real code after every https:// scheme), adds renderItems/buildName to the dump targets, and reports brace-balance per recovered body so a bad slice is visible instead of silent. Scraper id and manifest path stay stable so Nuvio keeps your saved Session Cookie.

scrapers.name: CinemaCity Download Lab v2.0.0
scrapers.description: DUI8BUILD=9.0.0. Dumps full download orchestration function bodies to logcat (grep CCDUMP) and as chunked DUI8B rows, with per-body brace-balance verification.
